connector.name: Gmail MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Lean Gmail MCP server with auto authentication support
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gmail-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the artymclabin account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH
env.description: Optional override for the OAuth client keys file path (defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/gcp-oauth.keys.json)

env.name: GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH
env.description: Optional override for the stored credentials file path (defaults to ~/.gmail-mcp/credentials.json)
